## Why This Is Asked

- Cross‑account IAM roles with explicit external IDs

```javascript

  "Version": "2012-10-17",

}
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design tenant isolation with modern IAM concepts beyond basic cross-account access.

- IAM Identity Center for SSO-driven short-lived credentials
- Per-tenant S3 prefix scoping and KMS key rotation

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",

      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "s3:prefix": ["${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}/*"]
        }
      }

}
```

6. 60-second breach containment: revoke sessions, invalidate credentials
